provenance: Assistant-reviewed complete public caption text from seven retrieved videos. Development cases, not independent human or video ground truth. Titles were not used as evidence for these labels.
review_scope: Dialogue and passage relationships only. Format, identical footage, recording identity and fair performance comparability are unverified.

reviewed_pairs.reason: Both transcripts follow the same audience-name, height, care-work, interpreter, couple-meeting and first-date exchange, with transcription variations.
The shorter transcript follows the sign-language exchange occurring near the end of the longer transcript; captions differ in filler and speaker rendering.
The texts cover separate passages; recurring participants suggest a possible narrative connection, but do not verify one recording.
Both discuss a returning audience member and a jacket; the passages cover different exchanges. This supports possible related narrative, not verified shared footage.
The second passage shifts from a drink interaction to a conversation about dogs with the same named participant. Continuity is possible, but recording identity is unverified.

One text concerns audience introductions and an interpreter; the other concerns an audience interruption and stage safety. Broad audience-interaction style does not establish matching topics or format.
The interpreter exchange and the returning-participant, jacket and drink exchange contain different dialogue despite common conversational vocabulary.

limitations: Seven development pairs from one channel are not independent held-out validation.
No verified video-format or shared-footage labels are available.
Ranking success is not a calibrated grouping decision. High scores occur for different dialogue.

Reports share the checked video inventory and original retrieval session. Semantic reports did not preserve caption hashes, so hash identity cannot be independently confirmed; no fresh retrieval is performed.
